svg.title: The four layers a manifest name resolves through
svg.desc: A manifest name is looked up in four places in order, and the first hit wins — the tenant's Postgres active pointer, a tenant-scoped object in the object store, a global object, then the YAML bundled into the image. Under FELIX_BUNDLED_ONLY the upper three layers do not exist and are not consulted at all, expressed by passing no store rather than by a branch in the deepest function on the path. A caller that names a version means it: an unknown version raises instead of falling back, because a silent fall-back to the active version is what once made a canary look benchmarked.
